# Anshkosh

> Anshkosh is a public validation platform for Indian startups before launch.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://anshkosh.com/): Overview of the public validation platform.
- [Discover startups](https://anshkosh.com/discover): Browse live startup profiles and evidence.
- [Categories](https://anshkosh.com/categories): Explore startups by industry category.
- [Journal](https://anshkosh.com/journal): Founder stories, startup insights, and validation guidance.
- [FAQ](https://anshkosh.com/faq): Questions about validation, campaigns, and participation.
- [Trust & Safety](https://anshkosh.com/trust-safety): Platform standards and accountability practices.
- [Contact](https://anshkosh.com/contact): Contact the Anshkosh team.

## Editorial and product context

Anshkosh is currently an early-access pilot. Public validation, applications, accounts, and interest lists may be available, but backing payments and reward orders are not currently open. Validation signals are not investments, securities, orders, revenue, or guarantees of delivery.
